# Next.js Standards

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Enterprise Standards](../../README.md) • [Technology Standards](../README.md)**

---

> This directory contains Next.js specific standards for enterprise environments. These standards provide comprehensive guidance for React application development, component architecture, state management, testing, and deployment patterns to ensure consistent and scalable Next.js applications.

These standards ensure consistent, secure, and scalable Next.js applications across the platform. They complement the general application standards with Next.js-specific guidance for:

- Component development and architecture patterns
- State management and data fetching strategies
- Frontend design systems and UI consistency
- Error handling and logging practices
- Security scanning and vulnerability management
- Testing strategies and quality assurance
